subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Mrs. Liu quickly helped clean it before anyone else fell.”?
options: The school newspaper printed the wrong date for the music concert.
The next week, another student lost a button before a school photo.
The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.
The student council decided to make a new map.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The school newspaper printed the wrong date for the music concert.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The next week, another student lost a button before a school photo.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Mrs. Liu quickly helped clean it before anyone else fell. The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The student council decided to make a new map.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Mrs. Liu quickly helped clean it before anyone else fell. The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.」，答案為「The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
